vocabulary.meaning: An unexpected bad event that causes harm or damage

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक अप्रत्याशित घटना जो नुकसान या चोट पहुँचाती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 思いがけない出来事で害や損害を引き起こすこと

examples.sentence: There was an accident on the road.

translation.Japanese: 道路で事故がありました。

vocabulary.meaning: A serious situation that needs quick help

meaning_translation.Hindi: एक गंभीर स्थिति जिसमें तुरंत मदद की आवश्यकता होती है
meaning_translation.Japanese: 早急な助けが必要な深刻な状況

translation.Japanese: 緊急時は112に電話してください。
彼は足をけがしています。

vocabulary.meaning: A cut or break in the skin

meaning_translation.Hindi: त्वचा पर कट या फट जाना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 皮膚にできた切り傷や裂け目

translation.Hindi: घाव को पानी से साफ करें।
translation.Japanese: 傷を水で洗ってください。

vocabulary.meaning: Blood coming out from a wound

meaning_translation.Japanese: 傷口から血が出ること

examples.sentence: The cut is bleeding a lot.

translation.Hindi: कट से बहुत खून बह रहा है।
translation.Japanese: 切り傷からたくさん出血しています。

translation.Hindi: उसकी कलाई की हड्डी टूट गई है।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は手首を骨折しています。

vocabulary.meaning: To lose consciousness for a short time

meaning_translation.Hindi: कुछ समय के लिए होश खो देना
meaning_translation.Japanese: 短時間意識を失うこと

examples.sentence: He felt dizzy and almost fainted.

translation.Hindi: उसे चक्कर आया और वह लगभग बेहोश हो गया।
translation.Japanese: 彼はめまいがして、倒れそうになりました。

vocabulary.meaning: Not awake and not aware of things

meaning_translation.Hindi: न जागरूक और न ही होश में
meaning_translation.Japanese: 目が覚めておらず周囲がわからない状態

vocabulary.meaning: Injury caused by heat, fire, or hot liquid

meaning_translation.Hindi: गर्मी, आग या गरम तरल से होने वाली चोट
meaning_translation.Japanese: 熱や火、熱い液体によるけが

examples.sentence: Run cool water over a small burn.

translation.Hindi: छोटे जलने पर ठंडा पानी डालें।
translation.Japanese: 軽いやけどには流水をかけます。

vocabulary.meaning: A vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital

meaning_translation.Hindi: बीमार या घायल लोगों को अस्पताल ले जाने वाला वाहन
meaning_translation.Japanese: 病人やけが人を病院へ運ぶ車

translation.Japanese: すぐに救急車を呼んでください。

vocabulary.meaning: Basic help given before a doctor arrives

meaning_translation.Hindi: डॉक्टर के आने से पहले दिया जाने वाला प्रारंभिक इलाज
meaning_translation.Japanese: 医師が来る前に行う基本的な手当

examples.sentence: She gave first aid to the injured man.

translation.Hindi: उसने घायल व्यक्ति को प्राथमिक उपचार दिया।
translation.Japanese: 彼女はけが人に応急手当をしました。

vocabulary.meaning: A bad reaction to food, medicine, or other things

meaning_translation.Hindi: भोजन, दवा या अन्य चीज़ों से होने वाली खराब प्रतिक्रिया
meaning_translation.Japanese: 食べ物や薬などに対する体のよくない反応

translation.Japanese: 彼はピーナッツアレルギーがあります。

vocabulary.meaning: An uncomfortable or hurting feeling in the body

meaning_translation.Hindi: शरीर में असहज या चुभने जैसा एहसास
meaning_translation.Japanese: 体に感じる不快感や苦しさ

examples.sentence: She feels pain in her back.

translation.Hindi: उसे पीठ में दर्द हो रहा है।
translation.Japanese: 彼女は背中に痛みを感じています。

grammar_tips.title: Describing past events with past simple
grammar_tips.explanation: Use past simple to tell what happened. Example: I fell off my bike. He broke his arm.

explanation_translation.Hindi: घटी हुई घटनाएँ बताने के लिए साधारण भूतकाल का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: I fell off my bike. He broke his arm.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 起きた出来事を伝えるときは過去形を使います。例: I fell off my bike. He broke his arm.

grammar_tips.title: Saying where it hurts with 'have' and 'in/on'
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'I have pain in…' or 'My … hurts.' Example: I have pain in my chest. My head hurts.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'I have pain in…' या 'My … hurts.' का प्रयोग करें। उदाहरण: I have pain in my chest. My head hurts.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 『I have pain in …』『My … hurts.』を使います。例: I have pain in my chest. My head hurts.

grammar_tips.title: Asking for help in emergencies
grammar_tips.explanation: Use short urgent requests: 'Call an ambulance!', 'Help, please!', 'I need a doctor.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: आपात स्थिति में छोटे, तात्कालिक वाक्य प्रयोग करें: 'Call an ambulance!', 'Help, please!', 'I need a doctor.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 緊急時は短くはっきり頼みます：'Call an ambulance!'、'Help, please!'、'I need a doctor.'

grammar_tips.title: Giving immediate advice with should/shouldn't
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'should'/'shouldn't' for simple first aid advice. Example: You should press the wound. You shouldn't move him.

explanation_translation.Hindi: सरल प्राथमिक उपचार सलाह के लिए 'should'/'shouldn't' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: You should press the wound. You shouldn't move him.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 簡単な応急手当の助言には 'should' / 'shouldn't' を使います。例: You should press the wound. You shouldn't move him.

vocabulary.question: Which word means an unexpected event that causes harm?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा शब्द एक अप्रत्याशित घटना को दर्शाता है जो नुकसान पहुँचाती है?
question_translation.Japanese: 害を引き起こす思いがけない出来事を意味する言葉はどれですか？

vocabulary.question: An ambulance takes sick or injured people to hospital.

question_translation.Hindi: एंबुलेंस बीमार या घायल लोगों को अस्पताल ले जाती है।
question_translation.Japanese: 救急車は病人やけが人を病院に運びます。

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा शब्द थोड़े समय के लिए होश खोने का अर्थ है?
question_translation.Japanese: 短時間意識を失うことを意味する言葉はどれですか？

vocabulary.question: She gave ___ to the injured man.

私は昨日自転車から___。

question_translation.Hindi: क्रम में लगाएं: [hurt, my, head, I]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [hurt, my, head, I]
事故の後、私の腕が___。

sentence.question: You ___ press the wound to stop bleeding.

question_translation.Hindi: खून रोकने के लिए आपको घाव पर दबाव ___।
question_translation.Japanese: 出血を止めるために傷を押さえるべき___。

question_translation.Hindi: क्रम में लगाएं: [call, an, ambulance, immediately]
question_translation.Japanese: 並べ替え: [call, an, ambulance, immediately]

listening.audio_text: I broke my leg in an accident.

question_translation.Japanese: 話者に何が起きましたか？
話者は「彼女は意識不明です」と言いました。

listening.question: What advice did the speaker give?
listening.audio_text: You should put cool water on the burn.

question_translation.Japanese: 話者はどんな助言をしましたか？

options: Put cool water on the burn

listening.question: What is the problem?
listening.audio_text: He is bleeding from his arm.

question_translation.Japanese: 問題は何ですか？

listening.question: The speaker said: 'I need a doctor.'

question_translation.Japanese: 話者は「私は医者が必要です」と言いました。

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'There was an accident on the road.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'There was an accident on the road.'

speaking.answer: there was an accident on the road

question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'He is bleeding a lot.'
言ってください: 'Call an ambulance immediately.'

speaking.question: Say: 'I have pain in my chest.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'I have pain in my chest.'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'I have pain in my chest.'

speaking.answer: i have pain in my chest
